# 260_R6OPS.3 — `project.purge` job vanished without firing (F-R6WATCH.2-1 / BL-112)

## What

The armed `project.purge` job `57bbef6f` (verified `state=created` 2026-10-28,
`start_after=2026-10-30T21:41Z`, tombstone `01M3SK38…` `deleted_at=2026-09-30`) vanished without
firing — no worker-log execution, no pending row, tombstone surviving past the +30 d grace.

**Live diagnosis (prod read-only, IAP tunnel `BEGIN READ ONLY`, $0):** the job's `keep_until` was
2026-11-13 (queue `retention_seconds`=14 d — retention sweep ruled out); it went **terminal** on or
before ~11-04 and was pruned by the 7-day `deletion_seconds` rule. Zero handler log lines AND zero
`error` events since 10-28 — pg-boss 12 `#processJobs` swallows handler throws (fails the job
silently, no `error` event) and the worker logs only after the handler returns: a throwing purge
disappears with no trace. Root-cause class: an armed purge job can go terminal unexecuted and
unnoticed — **the 30-day contract had no watchdog**.

## Fix (the class's loss path)

- `apps/worker/src/jobs.ts` — **`handleProjectPurgeSweep`**: every tombstone must hold a live
  (`created`/`retry`/`active`) `project.purge` job under its singleton key; orphans are re-armed at
  their own grace end (`startAfterMs = max(0, deleted_at+30d−now)`; send failure never fails the
  sweep — next tick retries).
- `apps/worker/src/main.ts` — the sweep rides the hourly `test-tenant.purge` tick (best-effort,
  logged); the purge consumer now logs the project id + error BEFORE rethrowing on a handler
  failure, keeping pg-boss retry semantics while making the silent path loud.
- `apps/worker/src/jobs.test.ts` — 7 focused tests (PGlite + `pgboss.job` stub): past-grace re-arm
  fires immediately, in-grace re-arm lands at the grace end, live-job suppression, terminal-row
  re-arm, fresh-tombstone/live-project skips, no-deps no-op.

## Survivor re-arm (PROD WRITE — operator act, not performed)

On the next worker deploy the hourly sweep re-arms `project.purge:01M3SK38…` automatically and the
consumer purges the tree. Manual re-arm steps for pre-deploy urgency are recorded verbatim in
`docs/build/runs/260_R6OPS.3.md` §Survivor re-arm.
